official: 大田区家庭的保育事業等の設備及び運営に関する基準を定める条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会区長提出議案

name: 保育事業者に性暴力防止措置を義務付け
summary: 家庭的保育事業者等に、乳幼児への性暴力を防ぎ、発生した場合に乳幼児を保護するための措置を義務付けます。利用乳幼児と接する業務のうち、支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で接する人について、犯罪事実確認などを行います。令和8年12月25日から施行されます。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等を防ぎ、発生時に利用乳幼児を保護する措置を講じる
利用乳幼児と接する一部の業務従事者について犯罪事実確認などを行う
who: 家庭的保育事業等を利用する乳幼児
利用乳幼児と接する業務の従事者
why: 家庭的保育事業等の設備及び運営に関する基準の改正に伴い、児童対象性暴力等の防止に関する規定を整えるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Requires childcare providers to take measures to prevent sexual violence
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ota City Ordinance Establishing Standards for Equipment and Operation of Home-Based Childcare Services, etc.
en.summary: The ordinance requires providers of home-based childcare services and similar services to take measures to prevent sexual violence against infants and toddlers and to protect them if it occurs. Criminal record checks and other checks will be conducted on people whose work involves contact with children using these services in settings with a power imbalance, ongoing contact, and a closed environment. It takes effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Take measures to prevent sexual violence against children, etc.
Protect infants and toddlers using the services if such violence occurs

Conduct criminal record checks and other checks on some workers whose jobs involve contact with children using the services in settings with a power imbalance, ongoing contact, and a closed environment
who: Infants and toddlers using home-based childcare services and similar services
Providers of home-based childcare services and similar services
Workers whose jobs involve contact with children using the services
en.why: The ward says the provisions on preventing sexual violence against children, etc. are being established in connection with amendments to the standards for equipment and operation of home-based childcare services and similar services.
